## About

I am a PhD student in the Department of Psychology at Western University. My research interests span the domains of close relationships and psychometrics. I am particularly passionate about investigating the nature and structure of trust in romantic relationships, as well as developing software tools to streamline measurement invariance testing.

## Research Interests

- Romantic relationships
- Trust
- Psychometrics
- Research software development
